core_engine: Playing cards from exile triggers Prosper to create Treasure tokens, which fuel further impulse draws and trigger high-density artifact sacrifice/drain payoffs.

engine_stages.trigger: Impulse exile draw engines (Light Up the Stage, Reckless Impulse, Passionate Archaeologist, Outpost Siege)
engine_stages.converter: Prosper, Tome-Bound (creates Treasure whenever playing cards from exile) + Xorn / Academy Manufactor token amplification
engine_stages.payoff: Treasure sacrifice and ping drain (Marionette Master, Mayhem Devil, Reckless Fireweaver, Mirkwood Bats, Disciple of the Vault)

expected_additions.rationale: Provides immediate impulse exile advantage and red mana ritual at a playable 3-mana curve point rather than an uncastable 10-mana sorcery.
Provides free instant-speed removal with commander out, replacing a low-impact combat goad aura.

specific_checks.description: Essential mana engine that refunds red mana on every impulse cast.
Triples token generation by converting each Treasure into Clue, Food, and Treasure.
10 CMC sorcery that represents massive curve friction and frequently rots in hand.
Suboptimal 3-mana rock with high sacrifice activation cost when cheaper rocks and treasure ramp abound.
